school.elementalarcana.fire.desc: Raw, burning power. Strikes hard and leaves enemies ablaze.
school.elementalarcana.water.desc: Flowing and restorative. Pushes foes away and mends allies.
school.elementalarcana.ice.desc: Cold and precise. Slows, freezes and controls the battlefield.
school.elementalarcana.wind.desc: Swift and free. Rides the air and scatters anything close.
spell.elementalarcana.fireball.desc: Hurls a bolt of fire that burns what it hits.
spell.elementalarcana.flame_burst.desc: A ring of fire erupts around you, burning everything close.
spell.elementalarcana.tidal_wave.desc: A wave that pushes enemies back and puts out fires.
spell.elementalarcana.healing_rain.desc: A soothing shower that regenerates you and nearby players.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.desc: Hold to form an icicle that grows sharper, release to launch it. Full charge freezes the target.
spell.elementalarcana.frost_nova.desc: Flash-freezes everything around you in place.
spell.elementalarcana.gale_dash.desc: Ride the wind forward. Your landing is soft.
spell.elementalarcana.updraft.desc: A column of wind throws you and nearby foes skyward.
message.elementalarcana.not_awakened: Your magic has not awakened yet
message.elementalarcana.overcast: You overcast, paying with your life force!
message.elementalarcana.new_affinity_slo: A new affinity can be awakened! Press %s to open your Status.
hud.elementalarcana.not_awakened: Your magic sleeps. Press %s to awaken it.
screen.elementalarcana.wheel.hint: Point at a spell, release %s to choose
screen.elementalarcana.awakening.subtitl: Choose the element your magic answers to. This choice is permanent.
Your power has grown. Choose another element to awaken.
message.elementalarcana.dev_no_permissio: The dev menu needs cheats enabled or operator permission
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.1.desc: Hold to form an icicle, release to launch it. A full charge freezes the target.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.2.desc: Two icicles form, one over each shoulder, and fly together.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.3.desc: Icicles charge in 0.75s, and even a quick tap-throw hits harder.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.4.desc: Three icicles form a crescent above you.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.5.desc: Choose a path: Piercing Cold or Shatterburst.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.6.desc: +25% damage, and full-charge freezes last longer.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.7.desc: Icicles curve toward the enemy nearest your crosshair.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.8.desc: Five icicles form an arc and fire in a rapid ripple.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.9.desc: Three hits from one volley freeze an enemy solid for 2 seconds.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.tier.10.des: Choose a path: Glacial Lance or Endless Winter.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.pier: Icicles pass through up to 2 enemies and fly 30% faster.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.shat: Icicles explode on impact, hitting everything within 2 blocks for half damage.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.lanc: Keep holding after full charge: your icicles fuse into one giant lance that pierces everything.
spell.elementalarcana.icicle.branch.wint: Kills refund half the cooldown. Full-charge hits leave frost patches that slow enemies.
message.elementalarcana.mastery_full: %s has mastered its level! Open your Status (%s) to level it up.
message.elementalarcana.branch_available: %s: a new path awaits. Open its skill tree to choose.
message.elementalarcana.respec.cooldown: You can reforge your paths again in about %s min
message.elementalarcana.respec.mana: Reforging your paths needs a full mana bar
message.elementalarcana.respec.done: %s's paths have been reset. Choose again.
tooltip.elementalarcana.click_for_detail: Click to open its skill tree
screen.elementalarcana.detail.respec.hin: Reset this spell's paths so you can choose again. Uses all your mana; once per day.
screen.elementalarcana.detail.locked: You can't cast this spell yet
screen.elementalarcana.detail.need_maste: Cast this spell more to fill its mastery bar
screen.elementalarcana.detail.need_point: No skill points. Gain Magic Levels to earn more
screen.elementalarcana.detail.respec.con: Its chosen paths will be cleared so you can pick again. This drains all your mana and can only be done once per day.
screen.elementalarcana.detail.branch.con: %s  This choice is permanent (it can only be undone by reforging).
